# Support

Start with [Installation](../docs/installation.md), [Usage](../docs/usage.md), and [Troubleshooting](../docs/troubleshooting.md).

For a reproducible bug or feature request, use [GitHub issues](https://github.com/magrathean-uk/uncordex/issues). Include the Uncordex version or source commit, macOS version, Mac architecture, reconnection rule, steps, expected behavior, and observed result. State whether the result came from fixtures or real hardware.

Share only the smallest redacted excerpt needed to explain the problem. Remove Bluetooth addresses, source keys, serial numbers, usernames, paths identifying your account, and unrelated log entries. Do not attach an entire configuration or runtime-state file.

For a suspected vulnerability, follow [the security policy](SECURITY.md) before posting details publicly.
